summary: Iteration 2 focused on the new video sample section and new covers on /medical-6-combo. Backend: extended /app/backend/tests/test_medical_combo6.py with 3 new tests (combo gallery includes cover-medicine + cover-lab-report, combo-6 add-ons expose correct cover_image, and all 9 public cover PNGs return HTTP 200). All 15 pytest tests pass. Frontend: Playwright automation on live preview URL verified all regression sections present, 6 pill tabs (disease/medicine/lab/emergency/ecg/ayurvedic) render with cover thumbnails, default Disease tab active with blue #2563EB background, phone mockup renders with a single <video data-testid=combo6-video-player> having autoplay/muted/loop/playsInline/preload=metadata, correct poster + src for selected guide, tab-switch to ECG swaps src -> ecg_reading_guide_page_flow_web.mp4, poster -> cover-ecg.png and title -> 'ECG Reading Guide' (only 1 video element in DOM at a time), 'Get this + 5 more guides' CTA smooth-scrolls to #pricing, all 6 'what you get' guide-card covers point to the new real PNGs. Mobile 390x844: no horizontal page overflow, tab row is horizontally scrollable, phone mockup (top ~1545px) renders above the text block (top ~1997px). Video mp4 404s are expected per spec; poster fallback confirmed by poster attribute wiring.
critical_code_review_comments: MedicalCombo6.jsx is 485 lines — consider splitting the video sample section into its own component for maintainability.

IntersectionObserver uses rootMargin 400px which effectively mounts the video on initial render for most desktop viewports since the section sits <400px below the hero when scrolled slightly; this still matches the lazy-load intent but strict pre-scroll absence can't be guaranteed on tall viewports.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Base URL https://ledger-website.preview.emergentagent.com. Video mp4 files under /samples/combo-6/videos/ are intentionally missing — poster fallback is expected. When owner uploads mp4s, re-test actual playback (not just attribute wiring). Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_medical_combo6.py (15 tests).
